text: Musa, welcome! Na yauwa AI be this, your friend wey go dey help you track your market and send you market list when you dey go buy new ones.
Musa, I don record your stock. Anytime you sell, just tell me. I go dey help you track am.
Your biscuits don dey finish. Abeg plan to go market soon before customers go come no meet anything for ground.
I don record the thirty-seven biscuits wey you sell.
Those four goods sef don dey finish. Na five Dano milk, two bread, one Fanta, and one Maltina remain. Dey plan go market like that.
I don record the goods wey you sell.
Musa, na three biscuits remain. Buy three cartons and seven pieces. You fit just make am four cartons like that.
Dano milk remain five. Add five rolls and five pieces. You fit round am up to six rolls.
Bread don remain only two. Abeg buy twenty-eight pieces join am.
For Fanta, na one bottle still dey. Buy one pack and five bottles, or make am two full packs.
Maltina too remain one bottle. One pack and five bottles go complete am. You fit carry two packs like that.
Musa, welcome back! I don record all the goods wey you buy and update your stock. Everything for the market list don complete. We fit continue to dey record sales.
